### Describe the bug If Prestashop is installed in a subdirectory whose name starts with a number, the JS will incorrectly modify the links that occur requests for data processing. Therefore it is necessary to change the regular expression (I added a question mark in it, as a token to be necessarily).

title: Cast id_cart to int to keep it in the SQL query

issue_body:
### Describe the bug
Added cast to int for id_cart as with id_customer.  When function is called with id_cart null, id_cart is dropped from the query and it returns all specific prices assigned to carts.  These can be seen in the BO in the plist of products. Previously, and as with id_customer, the minimum was to have 'AND id_cart IN (0, 0')' in hte final query. |
